notes.title: Possible Features & Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I want to thank you all again, this game is getting a lot more attention than I expected! First off, if you are interested in getting this game, you're probably not looking here, but if you are, then check out these reviews (one of them is in Dutch):

[url=http://www.game4me.be/review-contract/]G4ME[/url]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/el_kemosabe/recommended/409170/]No Drama, Just Reviews[/url]

Moving onto the main topic, I wanted to ask all of you:
[list]
 [*]What kind of bugs you have been experiencing that need fixing?
 [*]What you would like to see added to the game? 
[/list]

Just post it in the comments here and I'll have a look and see what I can do. I want this game to be at it's best and you're the people playing it so suggest away I'd say!

And if you like Contract, dropping a positive review wouldn't hurt either ːsteamhappyː

-Sylvain

notes.title: Hotfix 0.1
notes.notes:
Hotfix 0.1 is live right now! The amount of bugs is far less than expected so here is the first small patch already!

[list]
[*] Removed an enemy on level 18
[*] Small text issues resolved
[*] Added a button to skip to the next music track [M]
[*] Made the quit more direct
[*] Added more blood ːsteammockingː
[/list]

Thank you all for the support! I hope you have a good day and enjoy Contract!

-Sylvain
